messages:
olivia: Heads up — master CI is red on linux-x86-64, failing intermittently in tests/serve/test_retry.py::test_retry_window_alignment. Seen ~2 failures in the last 60 runs.

olivia: failing assertion in logs:
```
E   AssertionError: expected remaining_retries == 0
E   assert 1 == 0
E   tests/serve/retry.py:142 in test_retry_window_alignment
```

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @olivia — https://ci.example/red/4509871234/rerun (queued) :repeat:

tariq: any recent changes to scheduler/timers? I remember a perf tweak landed last week that touched timer coalescing.

olivia: only a small refactor around timer epoch handling (PR 9a7b3e). It was supposed to be behavior-preserving but could affect ordering under tight timing.

maria: can you try with a deterministic clock shim? If test depends on monotonic ordering, injecting a fake clock avoids noise and isolates whether it's a race.

jamal: I'll take a look. Command I'll use to triage:
```bash
TEST_SEED=12345 pytest tests/serve/test_retry.py::test_retry_window_alignment -k alignment -q --maxfail=1 -vv
# and then loop seeds: for s in $(seq 1000 1100); do TEST_SEED=$s pytest ... || { echo "seed $s failed"; break; }; done
```

olivia: thanks — when you find a seed that fails, paste the seed + small log snippet. :pray:

sre-oncall: infra quick check — no infra incidents in the last hour, runners healthy, network flaps none.

jamal: ran a short sweep, reproducer found at seed 1043. Minimal log:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] INFO retry_controller: scheduling retry in 30ms (backoff=1)
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] INFO session: resume called, kv_cache size=12
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] ERROR test: expected 0 retries left but got 1
```

maria: that looks like a ordering window: retry scheduled while session resume increments a counter. If timer wakeups can reorder across epoch boundary, you can get an extra retry. Stubbing monotonic would tell us if it's purely timing.

jamal: bisecting now between master and pre-9a7b3e, will report.

olivia: if this is the timer coalescing change we may need a targeted fix (ensure epoch comparisons are stable) rather than increasing sleeps in tests. Want to avoid masking.

jamal: update — bisect points to PR 9a7b3e as the introducing change. Repro rate goes from ~1/50 to ~1/25 after it. Looks like a branch in timer alignment that reduces micro-waits and exposes the race.

jamal: quick patch I tested locally: make timers compare using (epoch, seq) pair instead of just epoch. Small perf cost but deterministic ordering for same-epoch timers. Tests went green in 200 successive runs for seed sweep.

olivia: can you open a PR with the patch + a short test that asserts deterministic ordering under fake clock? Add CHANGES note. I'll review and try to run against CI.

jamal: on it, PR up: https://git.example/infra/patches/452 - includes test + changelog. :rocket:

olivia: awesome, will kick CI once merged and follow up if flake persists. Thanks all. :tada:
